posts.title: QTCat: Queer and Trans People in Category Theory
posts.description: I just saw a poster for the QTCat workshop, which is a workshop for queer and trans people in category theory, which is being held this August 12-14, 2026 in Hamburg. posts.title: Bidirectional Typechecking That Does Not Stop
posts.description: I’ve been implementing a new language, and one of the things I have been doing is implementing a language server for the first time. Interestingly, this has changed how I will write bidirectional typecheckers from now on!
